config.title: Backlog Now
config.description: Open tickets for the selected teams right now, whatever the dashboard timeframe

dataSourceConfig.sql:
WITH "o" AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN COALESCE("responsibleFullName", '') IN ('', '(Unassigned)') THEN '(Unassigned)' ELSE "responsibleFullName" END AS "tech", "statusClassName" = 'On Hold' AS "onHold" FROM "open")
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "open",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT "onHold") AS "active",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "onHold") AS "onHold",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "tech" = '(Unassigned)') AS "unassigned",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT "onHold" AND "daysOld" > 7) AS "activeOlderThan7d",
  ROUND(MEDIAN("daysOld"), 1) AS "medianAgeDays"
FROM "o"

config.title: This Period
config.description: Tickets opened and closed in the dashboard timeframe, and the median time to resolve

dataSourceConfig.sql:
WITH "c" AS (SELECT * FROM "created"),
"d" AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN COALESCE("responsibleFullName", '') IN ('', '(Unassigned)') THEN '(Unassigned)' ELSE "responsibleFullName" END AS "tech" FROM "closed")
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "c") AS "opened",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "d") AS "closed",
  ROUND((SELECT MEDIAN(DATE_DIFF('minute', "createdDate", "completedDate")) / 1440.0 FROM "d" WHERE "statusClassName" = 'Completed' AND "completedDate" IS NOT NULL), 1) AS "medianResolveDays"

config.title: Resolved by Due Date
config.description: Tickets resolved in the dashboard timeframe that had a due date, and the share resolved by it

dataSourceConfig.sql:
WITH "d" AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN COALESCE("responsibleFullName", '') IN ('', '(Unassigned)') THEN '(Unassigned)' ELSE "responsibleFullName" END AS "tech" FROM "closed")
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "completedDate" <= "resolveByDate") / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "resolvedByDuePct"
FROM "d" WHERE "statusClassName" = 'Completed' AND "completedDate" IS NOT NULL AND "resolveByDate" IS NOT NULL

config.title: Insights
config.description: Rules over the open backlog and the period's arrivals and closures

dataSourceConfig.sql:
WITH "o" AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN COALESCE("responsibleFullName", '') IN ('', '(Unassigned)') THEN '(Unassigned)' ELSE "responsibleFullName" END AS "tech", "statusClassName" = 'On Hold' AS "onHold" FROM "open"),
"c" AS (SELECT * FROM "created"),
"d" AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN COALESCE("responsibleFullName", '') IN ('', '(Unassigned)') THEN '(Unassigned)' ELSE "responsibleFullName" END AS "tech" FROM "closed"),
"t" AS (SELECT "tech", COUNT(*) AS "n" FROM "o" WHERE "tech" <> '(Unassigned)' GROUP BY "tech"),
"top" AS (SELECT "tech", "n" FROM "t" ORDER BY "n" DESC, "tech" LIMIT 1),
"oldest" AS (SELECT "ticketId", "daysOld", "tech" FROM "o" WHERE NOT "onHold" ORDER BY "daysOld" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1),
"s" AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "o" WHERE NOT "onHold") AS "active",
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "o" WHERE "onHold") AS "onHold",
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "c") AS "opened",
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "d") AS "closed",
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "o" WHERE NOT "onHold" AND "daysOld" > 7) AS "gt7",
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "o" WHERE NOT "onHold" AND "daysOld" > 30) AS "gt30",
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "o" WHERE "onHold" AND "daysOld" > 30) AS "holdGt30",
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "o" WHERE "tech" = '(Unassigned)') AS "unassigned",
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "o" WHERE (LOWER("priorityName") LIKE '%high%' OR LOWER("priorityName") LIKE '%critical%'
 OR LOWER("priorityName") LIKE '%urgent%' OR LOWER("priorityName") LIKE '%emergency%')) AS "high",
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "o" WHERE "isSlaViolated") AS "slaViolated",
    (SELECT MEDIAN("n") FROM "t") AS "medianLoad"
)
SELECT "severity", "rule", "insight" FROM (
  SELECT 1 AS "ord", 'Capacity' AS "rule",
    CASE WHEN "opened" > 1.1 * "closed" THEN 'warning' ELSE 'success' END AS "severity",
    CASE WHEN "opened" > "closed"
      THEN 'Arrivals outpaced closures: ' || "opened" || ' opened, ' || "closed" || ' closed (net +' || ("opened" - "closed") || ').'
      ELSE 'Closures kept pace with arrivals: ' || "opened" || ' opened, ' || "closed" || ' closed (net ' || ("opened" - "closed") || ').' END AS "insight"
  FROM "s"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2, 'SLA',
    CASE WHEN "slaViolated" > 0 THEN 'error' ELSE 'success' END,
    CASE WHEN "slaViolated" = 0 THEN 'No open ticket has breached its SLA.'
         WHEN "slaViolated" = 1 THEN '1 open ticket has breached its SLA.'
         ELSE "slaViolated" || ' open tickets have breached their SLA.' END
  FROM "s"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 3, 'Aging',
    CASE WHEN "gt7" > 0.5 * "active" THEN 'error' WHEN "gt7" > 0 THEN 'warning' ELSE 'success' END,
    "gt7" || ' of ' || "active" || ' active tickets (' || COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * "gt7" / NULLIF("active", 0))::INTEGER, 0)
      || '%) are older than 7 days. ' || "onHold" || ' more are on hold, waiting on someone else.'
  FROM "s"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 4, 'Stale',
    CASE WHEN "gt30" > 0 THEN 'error' WHEN "holdGt30" > 0 THEN 'warning' ELSE 'success' END,
    "gt30" || CASE WHEN "gt30" = 1 THEN ' active ticket is' ELSE ' active tickets are' END || ' older than 30 days'
      || COALESCE('; the oldest is #' || (SELECT "ticketId" FROM "oldest") || ' (' || (SELECT ROUND("daysOld")::INTEGER FROM "oldest")
         || ' days, ' || (SELECT "tech" FROM "oldest") || ')', '')
      || '. ' || "holdGt30" || ' on-hold ' || CASE WHEN "holdGt30" = 1 THEN 'ticket has' ELSE 'tickets have' END || ' been open over 30 days.'
  FROM "s"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 5, 'Ownership',
    CASE WHEN "unassigned" > 0 THEN 'warning' ELSE 'success' END,
    CASE WHEN "unassigned" = 0 THEN 'Every open ticket has a named technician.'
         WHEN "unassigned" = 1 THEN '1 open ticket has no named technician.'
         ELSE "unassigned" || ' open tickets have no named technician.' END
  FROM "s"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 6, 'Balance',
    CASE WHEN (SELECT "n" FROM "top") >= 2 * "medianLoad" THEN 'warning' ELSE 'success' END,
    COALESCE((SELECT "tech" || ' holds ' || "n" FROM "top") || ' open tickets against a team median of ' || ROUND("medianLoad", 1) || '.',
             'No open tickets are assigned to a named technician.')
  FROM "s"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 7, 'Priority',
    CASE WHEN "high" > 0 THEN 'warning' ELSE 'success' END,
    CASE WHEN "high" = 1 THEN '1 high or critical priority ticket is open.'
         ELSE "high" || ' high or critical priority tickets are open.' END
  FROM "s"
) ORDER BY "ord"

config.title: Where Tickets Went
config.description: Tickets opened in the dashboard timeframe: team, then classification, then where each ticket is now

dataSourceConfig.sql:
WITH "c" AS (SELECT * FROM "created"),
"x" AS (SELECT "responsibleGroupName" AS "team",
    CASE WHEN "classificationName" = '' THEN '(No classification)' ELSE "classificationName" END AS "cls",
    CASE WHEN "statusClassName" = 'Completed' THEN 'Resolved' WHEN "statusClassName" = 'Cancelled' THEN 'Cancelled'
         WHEN "statusClassName" = 'On Hold' THEN 'On hold' ELSE 'Still open' END AS "outcome"
  FROM "c"),
"topCls" AS (SELECT "cls" FROM "x" GROUP BY "cls" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "cls" LIMIT 6),
"y" AS (SELECT "team", CASE WHEN "cls" IN (SELECT "cls" FROM "topCls") THEN "cls" ELSE 'Other' END AS "cls", "outcome" FROM "x")
SELECT "team" AS "source", "cls" AS "target", COUNT(*) AS "tickets" FROM "y" GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT "cls", "outcome", COUNT(*) FROM "y" GROUP BY 1, 2

config.title: Arrivals vs Closures
config.description: Tickets opened and closed per day

dataSourceConfig.sql:
WITH "c" AS (SELECT * FROM "created"),
"d" AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN COALESCE("responsibleFullName", '') IN ('', '(Unassigned)') THEN '(Unassigned)' ELSE "responsibleFullName" END AS "tech" FROM "closed")
SELECT STRFTIME(DATE_TRUNC('day', "day"), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') AS "day",
       SUM("opened") AS "opened", SUM("closed") AS "closed" FROM (
  SELECT "createdDate" AS "day", 1 AS "opened", 0 AS "closed" FROM "c"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "completedDate", 0, 1 FROM "d" WHERE "completedDate" IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

config.title: Backlog Aging
config.description: Open tickets by age: active, and on hold waiting on someone else

dataSourceConfig.sql:
WITH "o" AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN COALESCE("responsibleFullName", '') IN ('', '(Unassigned)') THEN '(Unassigned)' ELSE "responsibleFullName" END AS "tech", "statusClassName" = 'On Hold' AS "onHold" FROM "open")
SELECT "bucket", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT "onHold") AS "active", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "onHold") AS "onHold" FROM (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN "daysOld" <= 2 THEN '0-2 days' WHEN "daysOld" <= 7 THEN '3-7 days'
                 WHEN "daysOld" <= 14 THEN '8-14 days' WHEN "daysOld" <= 30 THEN '15-30 days'
                 ELSE 'Over 30 days' END AS "bucket",
            CASE WHEN "daysOld" <= 2 THEN 1 WHEN "daysOld" <= 7 THEN 2 WHEN "daysOld" <= 14 THEN 3
                 WHEN "daysOld" <= 30 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS "ord"
  FROM "o")
GROUP BY "bucket", "ord" ORDER BY "ord"

WITH "o" AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN COALESCE("responsibleFullName", '') IN ('', '(Unassigned)') THEN '(Unassigned)' ELSE "responsibleFullName" END AS "tech", "statusClassName" = 'On Hold' AS "onHold" FROM "open")
SELECT CASE WHEN "priorityName" = '' THEN '(None)' ELSE "priorityName" END AS "priority", COUNT(*) AS "open"
FROM "o" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY MIN("priorityOrder"), "priority"

config.title: Staff Workload
config.description: Open work per technician against the team median, and what each closed in the dashboard timeframe

dataSourceConfig.sql:
WITH "o" AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN COALESCE("responsibleFullName", '') IN ('', '(Unassigned)') THEN '(Unassigned)' ELSE "responsibleFullName" END AS "tech", "statusClassName" = 'On Hold' AS "onHold" FROM "open"),
"d" AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN COALESCE("responsibleFullName", '') IN ('', '(Unassigned)') THEN '(Unassigned)' ELSE "responsibleFullName" END AS "tech" FROM "closed"),
"ow" AS (SELECT "tech", COUNT(*) AS "open", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "onHold") AS "onHold",
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT "onHold" AND "daysOld" > 7) AS "activeOlderThan7d",
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT "onHold" AND "daysOld" > 30) AS "activeOlderThan30d",
           MAX("daysOld") AS "oldestDays"
         FROM "o" GROUP BY "tech"),
"cw" AS (SELECT "tech", COUNT(*) AS "closed",
           MEDIAN(DATE_DIFF('minute', "createdDate", "completedDate")) FILTER (WHERE "statusClassName" = 'Completed' AND "completedDate" IS NOT NULL) / 60.0 AS "medianResolveHours"
         FROM "d" GROUP BY "tech"),
"g" AS (SELECT "tech", STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "responsibleGroupName", ', ' ORDER BY "responsibleGroupName") AS "team" FROM (
           SELECT "tech", "responsibleGroupName" FROM "o" UNION ALL SELECT "tech", "responsibleGroupName" FROM "d") GROUP BY "tech"),
"m" AS (SELECT MEDIAN("open") AS "teamMedian" FROM "ow" WHERE "tech" <> '(Unassigned)')
SELECT "g"."tech" AS "technician", "g"."team",
       COALESCE("open", 0) AS "open", COALESCE("onHold", 0) AS "onHold",
       COALESCE("activeOlderThan7d", 0) AS "activeOlderThan7d", COALESCE("activeOlderThan30d", 0) AS "activeOlderThan30d",
       ROUND("oldestDays") AS "oldestDays",
       COALESCE("cw"."closed", 0) AS "closedInPeriod", ROUND("medianResolveHours", 1) AS "medianResolveHours",
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE("open", 0) / NULLIF((SELECT "teamMedian" FROM "m"), 0)) AS "loadVsMedianPct"
FROM "g" LEFT JOIN "ow" ON "ow"."tech" = "g"."tech" LEFT JOIN "cw" ON "cw"."tech" = "g"."tech"
ORDER BY "open" DESC, "closedInPeriod" DESC

config.title: Demand by Service
config.description: Tickets opened in the dashboard timeframe for the eight busiest services, split by classification

dataSourceConfig.sql:
WITH "c" AS (SELECT * FROM "created"),
"x" AS (SELECT CASE WHEN "serviceName" = '' THEN '(No service)' ELSE "serviceName" END AS "service",
               CASE WHEN "classificationName" = '' THEN '(No classification)' ELSE "classificationName" END AS "classification"
        FROM "c"),
"topSvc" AS (SELECT "service" FROM "x" GROUP BY "service" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "service" LIMIT 8)
SELECT "service", "classification", COUNT(*) AS "tickets"
FROM "x" WHERE "service" IN (SELECT "service" FROM "topSvc") GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY "tickets" DESC

config.title: When Tickets Arrive
config.description: Tickets opened in the dashboard timeframe by weekday and hour (UTC)

dataSourceConfig.sql:
WITH "c" AS (SELECT * FROM "created")
SELECT STRFTIME("createdDate", '%w %a') AS "weekday", LPAD(HOUR("createdDate")::VARCHAR, 2, '0') || ':00' AS "hourUtc",
       COUNT(*) AS "tickets"
FROM "c" GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

config.title: Open Tickets
config.description: Every open ticket for the selected teams, active work first, oldest first

dataSourceConfig.sql:
WITH "o" AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN COALESCE("responsibleFullName", '') IN ('', '(Unassigned)') THEN '(Unassigned)' ELSE "responsibleFullName" END AS "tech", "statusClassName" = 'On Hold' AS "onHold" FROM "open")
SELECT "link", "ticketId", "title", "responsibleGroupName" AS "team", "tech" AS "owner",
       "priorityName" AS "priority", "statusName" AS "status", ROUND("daysOld", 1) AS "ageDays",
       "createdDate", "resolveByDate",
       CASE WHEN "isSlaViolated" THEN 'SLA violated'
            WHEN NOT "onHold" AND "daysOld" > 30 THEN 'Stale'
            WHEN "tech" = '(Unassigned)' THEN 'Unassigned'
            WHEN "onHold" THEN 'On hold'
            ELSE 'OK' END AS "flag"
FROM "o" ORDER BY "onHold", "daysOld" DESC
